title: Data table
summary: A paged, searchable, sortable table that owns its data flow: a pk-table (manual), a pk-table-filters search/filter panel and a pk-pagination footer, with the query, the load and the states in one place. Set the load(query) callback as a property (business logic, never config data): it receives { page, pageSize, sort, sortDir, search, filters } and returns (or resolves to) { rows, total } for that page. A loading state shows while it is in flight, a rejection shows the built-in error state with Retry, zero rows show the configured empty state, and an older response arriving after a newer request is dropped. With selectable set, the selection survives paging and searching: selected holds the chosen ids, selectScope is 'page' (those ids) or 'all' (the reader chose Select all N rows of the query; the ids stay the loaded page, never every id). Each change raises pk-select with the ids, the scope and the current query, so for scope 'all' the host runs its bulk action against that query on the server. A search or filter change narrows scope 'all' back to 'page'. rowHref(row), also a callback property, makes rows clickable and is called with the row. pk-list-page and the lookup picker are built on this element.

props.name: config
props.description: { columns, filters?, empty?, pageSize?, pageSizeOptions?, sort?, sortDir?, searchable?, searchLabel?, searchDebounce?, pagerLabel?, label?, caption? }. columns is pk-table's own column definitions ({ key, label, type?, align?, sortable?, hidePhone? }[]). filters is [{ key, type: 'text'|'email'|'number'|'date'|'select', label, options? }] (a select's options are [{ value, label? }] or plain strings), rendered into the pk-table-filters panel and combined into query.filters as { [key]: text }. empty is { heading?, description? } shown when a page has zero rows. pageSize is the initial page size (default 25) and pageSizeOptions (for example [10, 25, 50]) the sizes the reader can choose from (none: no size select). sort (a column key) and sortDir ('ascending' or 'descending') are the initial sort, sent to load(query) and shown on the header; they apply until the reader changes the query. searchable: false hides the search box (default true); searchLabel is the search box's placeholder and accessible name (default 'Search'); searchDebounce the milliseconds after the last keystroke before the query changes (default 250); pagerLabel the pager's accessible name (default 'Pagination'); label the table's accessible name and caption its visible caption. Other keys are ignored, so a page can hand its whole config over.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Show a checkbox column and the bulk bar, with 'Select all N rows' when the query has more rows than the page.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: The row field that identifies a row, which is what selected holds.

props.name: clickable
props.description: Rows can be activated: a click, or Enter or Space on the focused row (each row is a tab stop), raises pk-row-click with the row id. For a host that cannot pass a rowHref callback (a wrapper, a page that opens the row itself). Setting rowHref makes rows clickable too.

props.name: currentRow
props.description: The id (rowKey value) of the row that is open elsewhere, for example in a detail pane: pk-table tints it, marks it with an accent bar and gives it aria-current. The host sets it, from the route or from pk-row-click.

props.name: cards
props.description: Rows become stacked cards on a phone, as pk-table's cards.

props.name: striped
props.description: Alternate row tint, as pk-table's striped.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: A CSS length that caps the table's height (the rows scroll inside it), as pk-table's maxHeight; combine with stickyHeader.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keep the header row visible while the rows scroll, as pk-table's stickyHeader.

props.name: selected
props.description: The ids of the selected rows, as strings, across every page and search the reader has visited. Set it to preselect; read it (or the pk-select event) to act on the selection. For selectScope 'all' it is only the loaded page: expand the scope with the query.

props.name: selectScope
props.description: 'all' once the reader chose Select all N rows: every row of the current query is selected, not only the ids in selected.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Toolbar buttons at the end of the search row.

slots.name: cell-<rowId>-<key>
slots.description: Custom content for one cell, exactly as pk-table's cell slots: the row's id (its rowKey field) and the column key. A row with no such child shows the plain value. Column options (align, type, hidePhone) in config.columns apply as in pk-table.

events.name: pk-row-click
events.description: pk-table's own event, passed through: a clickable row was activated. id is the row's rowKey value, row the row object from load(). A control inside the row (checkbox, button, link) does not raise it.

events.name: pk-select

detail.query: { page, pageSize, sort, sortDir, search, filters }

events.description: The selection changed (a row, the page or Select all N, a cleared selection, or a search that narrowed scope all to page). For scope 'all' run the bulk action against query on the server. pk-table's own pk-select and pk-select-all stop inside the element.

parts.name: filters
parts.description: The pk-table-filters search/filter panel, in the table's toolbar.

parts.name: actions
parts.description: Holds the actions slot, at the end of the toolbar.

parts.name: pagination
parts.description: The pk-pagination, in the table's footer.

parts.name: state
parts.description: Holds the loading/empty/error state while load() is in flight or the result is empty; the table is hidden while this is shown.

methods.name: refresh()
methods.description: Runs load(query) again for the current query, for example after a bulk action. Returns a promise.

methods.name: query
methods.description: A getter: a copy of the current query { page, pageSize, sort, sortDir, search, filters }.

a11y: Every filter field is a labelled real control (pk-input/pk-select, showLabel on); the table, search box, bulk bar and pagination keep their own roles, names and announcements ('Select all N rows' is a named button); the loading and error states use pk-skeleton and pk-alert's own roles and announcements.

examples.title: Orders (set load from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP; with none, the empty state shows)
examples.html: <pk-data-table selectable config='{"columns":[{"key":"sku","label":"SKU"},{"key":"name","label":"Name"}],"empty":{"heading":"No orders yet","description":"Orders you receive show here."}}'></pk-data-table>
